IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy blonde
hair wears a fuzzy blue and brown striped knit
cardigan with a hood, a bow tie at the neck, and
small brown buttons. A leopard-print skirt shows at
the hip. Her expression is calm and direct against a
soft gray backdrop. Soft, even studio light. Palette
of powder blue, chocolate, and leopard tan. Playful
and cozy, in the style of a knitwear catalog.
